queue.title: Imperfect-intervention transfer
queue.hypothesis: The supported width-2 breadth controller remains useful when interventions are soft/noisy rather than perfect do-operations.
queue.design: Observed linear five-node DAGs; requested intervention value is only partially imposed: target retains 35% of its natural structural equation and receives 65% of the requested setpoint plus intervention noise. Inference still treats the action as a perfect intervention. Compare corrected nested width1 vs width2 at equal intervention budget.
secondary_metrics: true-DAG mass interpreted cautiously under intervention misspecification

checkpoint.next_action: Do not resume historical world 13. A fresh separately labeled soft-intervention replication may be enqueued only after EXP-002R2 establishes a reproducible benchmark-v2 baseline.

queue.title: Canonical benchmark reconstruction and regression certification
queue.hypothesis: Durable protocol/result invariants are sufficient to reconstruct a reproducible canonical EXP-002 benchmark without post-hoc tuning.

checkpoint.conclusion: Earliest repository history contains no EXP-002 executable runner; untuned canonical-v1 passed structural invariants but produced width2-width1 edge delta +0.2581 over 8 paired worlds, opposite historical supported M2 direction. Historical J4 cannot be resumed or pooled.

queue.title: Fresh benchmark v2 preregistration and calibration controls
queue.hypothesis: A separately versioned benchmark using genuine posterior-predictive proposal scoring, matched budget 15, strict nested breadth, and atomic seed/state persistence can establish an exactly resumable prospective baseline without tuning to historical aggregates.

checkpoint.next_action: Implement genuine posterior-predictive EIG and deterministic designer definitions; serialize benchmark manifest and source hash; run four mechanics-only paired worlds, fixing only implementation bugs before freezing the baseline screen.

queue.title: Nonstationary transfer
queue.hypothesis: A controller with explicit model-uncertainty handling degrades less when mechanisms drift during the experiment trajectory.

established_findings: Unconditional two-step search does not improve the primary metric after RNG isolation and costs roughly 9x compute.
Initial-state and local-margin depth gates failed to justify deeper search.
Uniform width-2 proposal breadth improves edge recovery over width-1 across combined n=72 matched correctly specified historical worlds, with bootstrap CI excluding zero, at roughly 2x compute.
The historical width-2 gain is a portfolio effect rather than one globally best extra role.
Simple adaptive breadth thresholds failed strict preregistered validation; uniform width-2 remains the supported correctly specified historical benchmark controller.
Under nonlinear ground truth, forcing linear-Gaussian inference sharply degrades absolute recovery and does not preserve the width-2 breadth advantage.
Nonlinear-aware local likelihoods substantially repair absolute recovery under nonlinear ground truth, but the width-2 advantage remains unresolved at n=96 after corrected nested-breadth controls.
A simple linear-vs-nonlinear posterior-disagreement bonus changes many intervention choices but worsens edge recovery prospectively; model disagreement is not itself a useful proposal reward.

Among tested role-credit schemes, naive terminal trajectory credit is the only directionally promising one, but it remains unresolved at n=96 and does not yet justify replacing the unweighted width-2 controller.
A single unmodeled latent common cause can reverse the breadth advantage: width-2 lost all 12 screened pairs, so robustness requires model-class changes rather than more proposals alone.

The historical EXP-002 powered lineage is not exactly resumable from repository state because its executable runner and per-world seed/state ledger were not persisted; future experiments require atomic seed/state serialization before claims are pooled across runs.

Repository archaeology confirms the EXP-002 executable mechanics were not committed even in the earliest EXP-002 tree; the original README independently fixes corrected total intervention-cost budget at 15.

An untuned clean canonical-v1 reconstruction passed the 29,281-DAG structural invariants but failed behavioral regression, producing mean width2-width1 edge error +0.2581 over its first 8 matched worlds versus the historical supported negative effect. Historical J4 must remain nonpoolable; future transfer claims require a separately versioned fresh benchmark.
dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
